description: Rumpuputket is a dataset listed in Open Data Finland, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Väylävirasto. Rumpuputket ovat kuivatusrakenteita, joiden tarkoitus on johtaa avo-ojien ja vesistöjen pintavedet tien, kadun, sillan tai vesistöpenkereen alitse. Rummuiksi luetaan kaikki halkaisijaltaan alle 2000mm:n rummut. Tätä suuremmat ovat siltarumpuja eikä niitä hallita velhossa. Jos vierekkäin on kaksi rumpua (tuplarumpu), molemmat ovat Velhossa oma objektinsa. Rummut mallinnetaan Tievelhossa pistemäisinä objekteina. Coverage: Väylävirasto. The publisher named on the listing is Väylävirasto. Its keywords include Liikenneverkot, Ei-Inspire, Kansallinen, liikenne, varusteet, Velho. The listing shows 4 download or service links in WMS, WFS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-open-data-finland.
